headline: Inventory addition to drive growth in FY28E

highlights: RevPAR growth was modest at 7.2% given occupancy dipped 240bps YoY to 64.2% as MMR region proved to be a drag.

CHALET IN has been facing occupancy-led challenges in MMR region since the last 2 quarters amid flat international demand, ongoing construction work at Powai and renovation/rebranding at Four Points Sheraton (FPS), Navi Mumbai.
Despite these challenges, ARR in MMR region was up 8%/13% in 1Q/2Q indicating recovery in the RevPAR growth could be swift once occupancy bounces.
Aided by recovery in MMR region and addition of two marquee assets (Taj, Delhi and Tower-2, Powai) by next year, we expect sales/EBITDA CAGR of 17%/19% over FY26-FY29E.
valuation: We maintain BUY with a TP of INR1,055 as we value the hotel business at 18x Sep-28E EBITDA (no change in target multiple), annuity portfolio at a cap rate of 8.5% and the residential project at NAV of INR17 per share.

However, the construction is expected to commence in 4QFY27E. 11) At Udaipur, refurbishment work on the existing 141-room property has already commenced, while the potential expansion of additional rooms remains under evaluation. 12) Net debt stood at INR21,130mn as of Sep’26.
